text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Notice of the National Student Speech 
Contest... 
The school preliminaries are... in two 
weeks.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A composite art of structure and 
expressive power... 
Not bad. Sounds interesting.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You're entering the contest too, 
Scarlet-chan? 
Then we'll settle things at the 
preliminaries! I'm not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Transitioning here is... no, too early. 
I need to hook the audience's interest 
first. 
I should probably dig deeper into that 
last point—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet has been glaring down at her 
notebook since dusk. 
Apparently, she's working on a draft for 
the speech contest.
choice_data_list: You're really fired up about this.
You're really fired up about this.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am! I'm aiming for number one! 
Besides, with Eye entering, it's not gonna 
be a walk in the park.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Out of the five subjects, you beat me in 
three this time...! 
You really are amazing, Scarlet-chan... 
How frustrating! 
Next time, I'm winning across the board!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and I won't lose either. 
I'm aiming for a perfect score, so let's 
both do our best.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yeah, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(...Sure, I beat her in three subjects! 
But Eye still took first place overall...! 
Ugh, seriously, it's so frustrating!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: (Ugh... I have to tighten up my act...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Once Eye sets her mind on winning, 
her motivation is just off the charts.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She's definitely going to deliver 
something top-tier this time too. 
I can't afford to slack off for a single 
second...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, right. 
A personal experience here... I see. Then—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(An engaging topic and airtight logic, 
garnering empathy through both. 
That's my path to victory...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Just as expected of Scarlet-chan. 
She's crafting a manuscript honed to 
logical perfection.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll speak from personal 
experience. 
A message woven from genuine feelings is 
sure to resonate far deeper.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Is that Eye speaking up on the stage...? 
Practicing her speech in front of a 
crowd...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever felt a sense of growth 
when something you couldn't do yesterday 
became just a little bit easier today?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Finally solving a problem you struggled 
with. 
Getting better at cooking.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Or holding your ground all the way 
through a final stretch 
where you used to run out of steam. 
...Though, that was just me when I was 
little. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Nobody can do everything right from the 
start. 
But by stacking up every small wish to 
'get better,' 
we keep moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Tearful Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
—Even Eye was like that...? 
*Sniffle*... I want to... become 
stronger... too...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A topic grounded in personal experience... 
Eye came thoroughly prepared, too...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, she delivers it like she's 
having a constant dialogue with the 
audience. 
Her real strength is probably that 
incredible expressiveness.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A natural talent for winning empathy... 
If I want to be chosen as the 
representative— 
I have to surpass her on every single 
front.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll revise my structure from the ground 
up! 
The length of each point, the pacing of my 
pauses— 
I will take first place through sheer 
perfection...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...The school preliminaries are starting 
soon. 
Are you all set?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Couldn't be more ready. 
I'm going to blow everyone away!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Good. ...Though I've prepared something 
special too. 
The kind of speech that strikes straight 
to the heart.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on. I won't lose this battle for 
the spot! 
Not to you, Scarlet-chan, and not to 
anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Challenge accepted. 
The one who wins and moves on to the 
finals... is me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the day of the speech contest 
preliminaries arrived.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
'That goal is still far too high for you.' 
...I'm sure everyone has stopped in their 
tracks after hearing advice like that at 
least once.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even if fear made you hesitate, 
I want you to reach out your hand one more 
time...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—To shine the brightest, what is it that 
you must face? 
Won't you take a moment to reflect on that 
with me?!

text_block_list.name: Deeply Moved Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Face it... one more time...? 
I will... too...!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! Flawless structure! 
Outstanding expressive power! 
It is impossible to place one above the 
other!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, unprecedented though it may be, 
both Daiwa Scarlet 
and Almond Eye shall represent our 
academy!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. 
Who would've thought this could happen?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Guess that means we settle this at the 
finals!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet was chosen as an academy 
representative. 
Seeing her radiant smile makes me just as 
happy.
choice_data_list: All that hard work bore fruit!
All that hard work bore fruit!

It's wonderful having a rival to push you 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet was chosen as an academy 
representative. 
Seeing her radiant smile makes me just as 
happy.
choice_data_list: All that hard work bore fruit!
All that hard work bore fruit!

It's wonderful having a rival to push you 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, obviously, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It was all to become number one. 
I'd never hold back on putting in the 
work!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. 
Great job out there, Scarlet-chan.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If you're up for it, want to do a debrief 
right now? 
I want to polish things up even further 
for the finals!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. 
Let's pull no punches!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. 
Look at you, being pretty considerate.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well then... that new café by the station. 
If you ask nicely... I'll let you come 
along with me.
